source_decision.reason: Airbyte jobs, sources, destinations, connections, connector definitions, regions, dataplanes, identities, and groups are pipeline control-plane or administration resources. The official contract does not prove a canonical task, note, or user-work project Source with a durable version and honest deletion or tombstone model.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Airbyte Cloud requires three-minute Application access tokens, while the existing generic connection substrate had no OAuth2 client-credentials grant.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Added a reusable encrypted oauth2_client_credentials connection variant, origin-pinned form exchange, single-flight freshness gate, enrollment validation, and Airbyte preset schema.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The official access-token endpoint accepts the same client id and secret needed to authenticate every other operation; exposing it as a recipe would turn credentials into operation input.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Excluded POST /applications/token from the catalog and invokes it only inside the trusted connection adapter.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The Applications and source/destination read contracts can return client secrets or credential-shaped configuration.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Kept the capabilities admitted but suppressed all six sensitive GETs from bundled rendering workflows; token-returning POSTs are also marked sensitive.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Source and destination detail endpoints expose includeSecretCoordinates.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Removed that argument from caller control and pins includeSecretCoordinates=false in both bindings.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Six create/replace/patch source and destination operations omit requestBody.required despite requiring provider configuration to be meaningful.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Requires bounded complete body_raw on all 35 admitted JSON-body operations and sends exact application/json.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Seven list routes expose limit and offset fields that would conflict with automatic traversal.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Removes caller limit and offset, pins page size to the documented maximum 100, and advances offset by page size.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Three connector-definition responses expose previous and next links but their requests declare no continuation parameter.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Returns data as an explicit single-page result and refuses to invent a cursor, limit, or offset.

audit_findings_folded.finding: jobId is an int64 path parameter and Airbyte responses contain int64 ids, timestamps, byte counts, and row counts.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Exposes jobId as an exact decimal string and enables lossless unsafe-integer string parsing on every admitted response.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The aggregate OpenAPI carries the complete public operation set but omits global authentication metadata.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Uses the aggregate spec for completeness and separately hash-locks the official SDK bundle plus authentication guide for client-credentials and bearer-token truth.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The documentation redirect and OAuth callback are browser lifecycle routes, not recipe capabilities.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Excluded exactly those two GET routes and retained every buildable public data-plane operation.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Action POST /jobs can request reset work and DELETE operations cancel or remove pipeline and administration resources.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Classifies createJob and every DELETE as destructive; every mutation requires approval and non-idempotent POSTs receive no hidden retry.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Airbyte control-plane objects are tempting but dishonest task, note, or user-work project Sources.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Declares no work_entity_sources and records the semantic rejection in the audit fixture.
